title: Project P.I.T.T. Shift Scheduler: how to use it, Duck Crank block
description: Updated for 1.0.6: Use Project P.I.T.T. Shift Scheduler to schedule automatic or switchable tools; it will not act as a button for the Manual Duck Crank. Re-test old reports.
h1: Project P.I.T.T. Shift Scheduler: how to use it, Duck Crank block
quickAnswer: The Shift Scheduler controls supported automatic or switchable tools; it is not a button-press replacement for a Manual Duck Crank. Community testing shows Remote can work with the Scheduler, and it’s intended for devices you can turn on/off or that run automatically (fans, magnets are cited by players as examples to verify in-game). Official 1.0.6 notes only: "Fixed the shift scheduler inconsistencies." Re-test any pre-1.0.6 setups against the current build rather than assuming older reports still apply.

facts.label: Tool
facts.value: Manual Duck Crank: unsupported for Scheduler use (community test). Cannon: documented as linkable in current guides. Fan and Magnet: community-cited examples; verify in-game before relying on them.

facts.label: Connections
facts.value: Scheduler is for automatic or switchable tools you can enable/disable, not manual button machines. Remote has community-confirmed compatibility; other tools require testing and should not be assumed universal.

facts.label: Timing
facts.value: Do not rely on invented timer values here. The Scheduler is commonly used to split output, gather product, then release together for larger combo bonuses or timed/batch release setups; re-test older timing reports after 1.0.6.

facts.label: Current version
facts.value: Updated for 1.0.6 — Official Steam Update wording: "Fixed the shift scheduler inconsistencies." Re-test any pre-1.0.6 reports; the note does not detail what was changed.
